HTML entry page that preloads assets and loads the Firedancer app bundle.

# Purpose
This HTML file defines the entry page for the web application and sets the document metadata used by the browser. It declares the page language, character set, viewport settings, title, and the root element `#root` where the application mounts. The file also preloads the main font and several SVG assets, including `firedancer` and `frankendancer` logo files, so the browser can load them early. The `script` tag loads the main JavaScript module, and the `link` tag loads the compiled stylesheet for the application.
